query: PostgreSQL versioning policy end of life current version

message.content: PostgreSQL supports each major version for five years after its first release ([postgresql.org](https://www.postgresql.org/support/versioning/)). PostgreSQL 18 was released in September 2025 and is supported until November 2030 ([postgresql.org](https://www.postgresql.org/support/versioning/)). Managed offers follow the same calendar ([aws.amazon.com](https://aws.amazon.com/rds/postgresql/)).

url_citation.title: PostgreSQL: Versioning Policy
url_citation.content: The PostgreSQL Global Development Group supports a major version for 5 years after its initial release. PostgreSQL 18: first release September 25, 2025, final release November 14, 2030.
